spans.t: Ancient Coffin
An old coffin. It is slightly ajar. Yet something
shines from its bottom. You reach in and
find a stash of coins which you pocket
gladly. The stale air in the coffin that you
inhale fills up your lungs with toxins.
3t

spans.t: Ancient Coffin
An old coffin. It is slightly ajar. A small
amount of gold has been stashed as offerings
to the departed, along with some rusted
weapons and broken bottles. You cut yourself
on one of the rusted blades and you feel
your wound twitch from its toxin...
3t
3t

spans.t: Beast Carcass
Something has recently mutilated this
creature... You don’t wait to find out
what, but as you notice a bulbous postule
filled with pus protruding from its fur, it
explodes, violently scattering infectious
liquid all around. You try to cover your
hand and mouth but alas... you’re too late.
3t

spans.t: Eerie Spiderweb
A spiderweb with a strange glow to it.
There might be something behind it, a
dusty trinket! When your hand brushes
against its silken strands, a maelstrom
of emotions washes over you.

spans.t: Left Luggage
Someone dropped this recently. Probably
on the run. It has a lock on it. Opening it
you find a small fortune with a small adder
hiding underneath it. It springs at your side
and injects you with its caustic venom.
3t

spans.t: Left Luggage
Someone dropped this recently. Probably
on the run. It has a lock on it. You smash
the lock and manage to find some gold
and a trinket. A springblade is flung into
your side, lodging between your ribs. Pain
washes over you as you start to bleed.
3t

spans.t: Mummified Remains
Ancient remains. The body looks well
preserved. Its innards are not, however,
for as you approach it a puff of caustic
bile is sprayed over your face. Covered
in the bodily humors of a rotten corpse,
you feel your face burning and itching...
3t

spans.t: Old Tree
This tree has a huge hole in the trunk.
Perhaps there’s something inside... In
it you find a trinket, but the bark’s
corossive properties damage your skin.
You draw back your hand in agony only
to realize that the damage is minimal. Yet
you have to treat the wound, gently.
3t

spans.t: Old Tree
This tree has a huge hole in the trunk.
Perhaps there’s something inside... In it
you find a trinket and some gold. As you
pocket your findings, a small poisonous
spider sneaks through the coins and bites
you sharply. You cough hard as you feel its
poison slowly creeping through your body...
3t

spans.t: Pristine Fountain
A beautiful fountain. It looks unaffected by the
surrounding chaos, its basin filled with gold. As you
pocket the money, a gooey liquid starts running from
the fountain’s openings. You manage to avoid most of
it but some wets your gloves. Your fingers begin to
itch and you feel a burning pain as you unglove your
hand, only to realize that its veins have turned black...
3t

spans.t: Pristine Fountain
A beautiful fountain. It looks unaffected by
the surrounding chaos. As you dislodge
a valuable stone from the statue’s grasp,
feelings of remorse and greed wash over
you. Deep in thought, you fail to realize
that the stone has been covered by a touch
poison to deter thieves from looting...
3t

spans.t: Shallow Grave
A grave, dug in haste. As you dig
deeper with your hands, you uncover
a sack of gold. You gradually become
aware that your nails have started
to itch and burn, whilst a yellow hue
turns the flesh soft and malleable...
3t

spans.t: Shallow Grave
A grave, dug in haste. Near it a small
bundle of provisions. You selfishly
pocket them only to discover a small
viper hiding underneath. With a rapid
movement it bites you on the hand,
injecting you with much unwanted venom.
3t

spans.t: Traveler’s Tent
Someone has camped here recently, and who
won’t return for sure. For as you enter the
tent, you find their abandoned backpack and
near it a rotten pig’s carcass. Its vile fumes
penetrate your nostrils as you try to keep
your balance. You exit the tent and gasp for
air, but the damage has already been done.

spans.t: Troubling Effigy
An unsettling effigy erected in service to a mysterious
god. On its base, a burlap sack filled with no ghosts
but some provisions. You grab it by the rope, and
realize that all the excretions and fluids from the
rotting body parts lodged on this effigy are trickling
down your skin. You feel the blight slowly creeping
into you as you reach out for an antidote.
3t

spans.t: Troubling Effigy
An unsettling effigy erected in service to a mysterious
god. On its base, a burlap sack filled with no ghosts
but some provisions. As you reach for the sack,
the effigy falls onto you, puncturing your shoulder
with its hard horns and splinters. You feel half
your body going numb, as your blood mixes with
rotten bile from the effigy in your open wound.
3t
3t
